intent: Follow the upper river into rapids, race across bridges, climb the cliffs, then rush downhill alongside the water. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

sections.name: The upper riverbank
sections.lesson: Keep your rhythm beside the current. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

signs.text:
The upper riverbank
Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

sections.name: At the rapids edge
sections.lesson: Bounce over the racing water. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

signs.text:

sections.name: The bridge network

sections.name: The riverside cliffs

sections.name: Down beside the river
sections.lesson: Carry the current’s direction into the descent. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.
